silhouette.note: Shirt sleeves, an open waistcoat, braces, a red neckerchief, full brown trousers and a pale slouch hat: Mount's raffle man and his cider makers, who read at 10 m as ours does (a pale shirt, a dark waistcoat, brown legs, a hat).

folds.note: The shirt sleeves are full but smooth to a plain wrist; every picture gathers them into a wristband with folds down the arm, and the shirt is beige-grey where theirs are white.

hat_hair.note: A pale broad-brimmed soft felt, as the Raffle man's; Weir's sawyer wears a battered black hat.

skin.note: Coloured pictures; a reconstructed face and complexion, no likeness asserted.

stance.what: How the figure stands or sits
stance.note: Upright; the pictures' men are at work (sawing, at the press), which no standing clip shows.

motion.note: A plain walk; the trousers break and swing.
